description: Before a larger x402 payment: the same allow / warn / block verdict and score as the free lumi_trust_check (paying never changes them), plus a live re-check of the seller at call time and a Lumi-signed receipt bound to the stated amount. Pass url and the USD amount you are about to pay (and optionally the payTo in its quote). Paid: priced as a small share of the stated amount, with a floor and a cap (exact price in the x402 quote; see lumi_quote).

amount.description: The USD amount you are about to pay, e.g. 10 (sets the price of this check)

payTo.description: Optional: the payTo address in its 402 quote

url.description: The x402 resource URL you are about to pay

name: lumi_high_value_check
title: Lumi: high value check (paid)
